figures.label: S4
figures.caption: Figure S4. An example of critical C-rate and Vend measurement from a full cell with 18 mg/cm2 cathode loading (2.7 mAh/cm2 area capacity) and a battery configuration as labelled in the figure. The battery was first charged and discharged at 0.3 C to measure the Vend turning point defined at 15 mAh/g capacity to the full discharge. After cycling at 0.3 C, 0.5 C, and 1 C, the battery was then discharged to 2 V at 0.3 C. In subsequent cycles to test the critical C-rate, the battery was charged at increasing C-rates started from 4 C and increased by 1 C per cycle, where the charge cutoff is always at 150 mAh/g charge capacity and discharged first quickly at 4 C to 2 V and then followed by 0.3 C to 2V in each cycle.
